w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Carpenter's square. Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Willow freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Gerhard: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Editor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Rosa opens the pantry wide: 5× Unknown flesh (dried), 2× Foraged food (dried), 1× Foraged food (dried). Roberto, Poran, Henrik, Omar eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Editor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone." (Talk to Owen.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Mixtape. Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — you hum them when you work, and the work goes faster. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
The crows are screaming — not the usual racket. They're screaming south, and you understand: something's moving in the woods, that way.
👁️ Nikos freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
firstContext: The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The ground, getting a new address. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE TIMESLOT! Gerhard joins you!
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Gerhard squares up to watch. "Give it hell."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Big Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: Village meal: +2470 kcal from the communal pantry.

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the north. They carried off ~1500 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 66 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE NETWORK NOTE! Omar, Nikos, Jorge join you!
firstContext: The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A memo, cc'd to the sky. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE NETWORK NOTE! Omar, Nikos, Jorge join you!
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Omar squares up to watch. "Give it hell."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 7 · Craft 2 · Talk 18 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOU ARE BACK IN THE MIDDLE — BOTH HANDS. THE PRAGMATIST'S REGISTER. I FIND IT... UNSETTLING. WHICH IS TO SAY: HUMAN."
◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Willow Ritchie reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.
